SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM public."Table_Catalog" WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('Stock_List', 'Stock_List_Member', 'Stock_List_Member_History', 'Stock_List_Load_Log', 'Stock_List_By_Ticker')), (SELECT count(*) FROM public."Column_Catalog" WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND (table_name IN ('Stock_List', 'Stock_List_Member', 'Stock_List_Member_History', 'Stock_List_Load_Log', 'Stock_List_By_Ticker') OR (table_name = 'Monitoring_Stockbit_Update' AND column_name = 'stock_lists'))), (SELECT count(*) FROM public."Column_Catalog" k WHERE k.table_schema = 'public' AND k.table_name IN ('Stock_List', 'Stock_List_Member', 'Stock_List_Member_History', 'Stock_List_Load_Log', 'Stock_List_By_Ticker') AND k.documentation_status = 'VERIFIED')
